text:
Which statement about the image of an object formed in a plane mirror is correct?
A
It is smaller than the object.
B
It is the same size as the object.
C
It is larger than the object.
D
It is inverted.

options.label: A
options.text: It is smaller than the object.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the same size as the object.

options.label: C
options.text: It is larger than the object.
